title: Per-request object allocation in middleware
summary: Flask before/after request hooks allocate expensive objects or clients on every request.
rationale: Middleware runs broadly, so small per-request overhead multiplies across every route.

impact.notes: Impact increases on high-traffic routes, large datasets, frequently rendered pages, or repeated background work.

remediation.guidance: Reuse clients safely, move expensive construction outside hot hooks, and limit middleware scope.
remediation.tradeoffs: Framework conventions, readability, caching correctness, and deployment topology should be considered before changing behavior.
